# @ntustray/web-authentication-component

Reusable authentication presentation/state library, not a hosted identity server or shared account database.

- README.md: start, install status, setup examples
- AGENTS.md: agent rules, commands, edit map, security boundaries
- docs/API.md: public configuration, adapters, React customization
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: state lifecycle, trust boundaries
- docs/CODE_GRAPH.md: generated module graphs and exported symbols
- docs/code-graph.json: machine-readable modules, declarations, static calls
- docs/MIGRATION.md: audited project patterns, adoption steps and current migration status
- SECURITY.md: server/identity-provider responsibilities and security helpers
- docs/REVIEW.md: reproduced multi-agent findings, fixes, regression coverage and 0.2 migration
- docs/PUBLISHING.md: npm first publish, trusted publishing, versioning

Entrypoints: root (framework independent), /react, /adapters/supabase, /adapters/better-auth, /adapters/neon, /adapters/hosted, /server, /styles.css.

Change flow: inspect contract -> change one layer -> add behavioral coverage -> format -> regenerate graph -> verify.
Operations expose id and pending/settling/redirecting phases. A timeout does not unlock the underlying SDK mutation. Background refresh must preserve failed sign-out privacy; explicit refresh() is a retry.
Never equate UI state with server authorization. Never put credentials/tokens in snapshots or analytics.
